subject_categories.label: Programs and Courses
subject_categories.definition: Academic programs, credentials, courses, curriculum, learning formats, and general program-selection information.

subject_categories.label: Admissions and Enrollment
subject_categories.definition: Public-facing application, admission, enrollment, and new-student information.

subject_categories.label: Tuition and Financial Aid
subject_categories.definition: Tuition, fees, payment options, scholarships, grants, loans, and general financial-aid information.

subject_categories.label: Academic Policy, Records, and Transfer Credit
subject_categories.definition: Academic policies, calendars, grades, registration records, transcripts, transfer credit, and degree-progress information.

subject_categories.label: Licensure and Accreditation
subject_categories.definition: Institutional or program accreditation, professional licensure disclosures, certification considerations, and state authorization.

subject_categories.label: Student Support and Accessibility
subject_categories.definition: Accessibility accommodations, academic support, technology help, wellbeing resources, and student services.

subject_categories.label: Career Services
subject_categories.definition: Career exploration, internships, experiential learning, employment preparation, and career-service resources.

subject_categories.label: Institutional Information
subject_categories.definition: General public information about the institution, locations, offices, contact channels, partnerships, and services.

subject_categories.label: General, Mixed, or Other
subject_categories.definition: Documents that are too broad, fragmentary, or mixed across unrelated subjects to have one clear primary subject.
exclude: documents with a clear dominant subject

document_function_categories.label: Program or Course Description
document_function_categories.definition: Descriptive information about an academic program, credential, course, curriculum, or learning format.

document_function_categories.label: Policy or Official Reference
document_function_categories.definition: Official rules, requirements, disclosures, standards, or reference information that governs an institutional decision.

document_function_categories.label: Guide or Procedure
document_function_categories.definition: Practical guidance explaining how a student or staff member completes a common task or finds the appropriate next step.

document_function_categories.label: FAQ or Overview
document_function_categories.definition: High-level explanatory material or frequently asked questions that summarize a subject without acting as a detailed policy or procedure.

document_function_categories.label: Calendar or Schedule
document_function_categories.definition: Information primarily organized around dates, deadlines, term structures, or scheduled events.
exclude: program pages that only mention duration

document_function_categories.label: Directory or Contact Information
document_function_categories.definition: Information primarily intended to help someone find an office, service, contact channel, or public destination.
exclude: procedures that merely include a contact

document_function_categories.label: General, Mixed, or Other Function
document_function_categories.definition: Documents whose purpose is unclear, combines several functions without a dominant one, or falls outside the defined functions.
exclude: documents with a clear dominant function

design_notes: Subject and function are independent; classify each document once on both dimensions.
Choose the dominant subject and function rather than assigning categories for passing mentions.
Source type, file path, department folder, and named people are not taxonomy categories.
Prefer the policy function when binding requirements dominate and the guide function when practical steps dominate.
Use fallback categories sparingly and only when no defined category is a reasonable fit.
